workResult: Applied Skill 04 to exactly the two completed same-date Reading Notes and produced two bounded Research Objects. Q-20260911-01 concludes that long-lived memory needs separate identities for immutable source observations, semantic relation judgments, active retrieval views and recovery evidence: ROAM shows that non-destructive atomic storage can coexist with mutable Primary/Evidence roles and improved tested memory-QA behavior, but deterministic transition after classification does not make the semantic classification objectively correct, and preserved evidence may still lose ordinary answer-time influence. Q-20260911-02 concludes that deterministic coordination may carry business meaning only when unit identity, candidate admissibility and relevant coupling constraints are sufficiently observable to make the decision contract complete; UnitBoost supplies comparative performance, provenance, residual-targeting and negative-condition evidence, while also showing that order-invariance is not semantic correctness and increasing coupling erodes independent unit selection. Both Research Objects are ReadyForProduction with production_input_authorized=true and publication_authorized=false. No article drafting, Production staging, cover generation or Publication was performed.
workResult_zh: Skill 04 严格只消费两份同日 Completed Reading Note，并生成两份有界 Research Object。Q-20260911-01 的结论是，长期 Memory 必须把 Immutable Source Observation、Semantic Relation Judgment、Active Retrieval View 与 Recovery Evidence 分成不同状态身份：ROAM 证明 Non-destructive Atomic Storage 可以与可变化的 Primary/Evidence Role 共存，并在测试的 Memory-QA 中取得改进，但分类后的确定性状态迁移并不会让语义分类本身变成客观事实，已经保留的 Evidence 也可能在普通 Answer-time Retrieval 中降低影响。Q-20260911-02 的结论是，只有 Unit Identity、Candidate Admissibility 与相关 Coupling Constraint 足够可观察、使决策合同完整时，Deterministic Coordination 才可以承载业务意义；UnitBoost 提供了比较性能、Provenance、Residual Targeting 与 Negative Condition 证据，同时也表明 Order-invariance 不等于 Semantic Correctness，Coupling 增强会侵蚀独立 Unit Selection 的适用性。两份 Research Object 均为 ReadyForProduction、production_input_authorized=true、publication_authorized=false。未执行文章写作、Production Staging、题图生成或 Publication。
